```python
from fractions import Fraction
from math import gcd

P = (
    (Fraction(1, 50), Fraction(7, 50)),
    (Fraction(7, 50), Fraction(49, 50)),
)
claimed = (7, 1)

# The image of a nonzero rank-one projection is its projected line.
assert P[0][0] * P[1][1] - P[0][1] * P[1][0] == 0
assert all(
    sum(P[i][k] * P[k][j] for k in range(2)) == P[i][j]
    for i in range(2) for j in range(2)
)
assert P[0][1] == P[1][0]

# Normalize the first nonzero column to a primitive integer vector.
column = (P[0][0], P[1][0])
denominator = (
    column[0].denominator * column[1].denominator
    // gcd(column[0].denominator, column[1].denominator)
)
a, b = (int(x * denominator) for x in column)
common = gcd(abs(a), abs(b))
a, b = a // common, b // common
if a < 0:
    a, b = -a, -b
expected = (a, b)

projected = tuple(
    sum(P[i][j] * claimed[j] for j in range(2))
    for i in range(2)
)
valid = (
    claimed[0] > 0
    and gcd(abs(claimed[0]), abs(claimed[1])) == 1
    and projected == claimed
    and claimed == expected
)

print("Expected primitive direction vector:", expected)
print("Submitted direction vector:", claimed)
print("Projection of submitted vector:", projected)
print("CHECK PASS" if valid else "CHECK FAIL")
```
